title: 第19章 助人为乐是骑士的美德第20章 李维你留一下
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
不同于以往，这股力量不是潺潺的暖流，而像是一条奔腾的江河，粗暴地冲刷着李维的每一根血管和神经。
这股巨大的力量像是一柄锤头一样猛地锤了他的胸口，产生了巨大的共振。
突如其来的能量让他感到一阵眩晕，他的心脏在胸腔里面剧烈的跳动，每一次跳动都带来了比以往更多量的氧气。
几秒钟之后，眩晕的感觉缓缓消失，取而代之的是一种全方位的升华感。
他试着握了握拳头。
从衣服并没有变得膨胀来看，身材似乎没有发生什么变化，但是手掌的皮肤似乎变得更坚韧了，他摸了摸自己的小臂肌肉，像是钢缆一样紧绷。
如果说1.1的力量让他还是个有点训练年限的普通健身爱好者，那么1.2的力量就让他感觉自己似乎已经开始脱离普通人的范围。
他看向旁边的挖掘机。现在他感觉只要跳一次就能跳上1米多高的履带。
他把视线又放到了新获得的【狂暴】上面。
【狂暴：激活后，30秒内力量、体质、敏捷判定翻倍，无副作用。】
【使用次数：每日1次】
虽然还没激活过，但是李维隐隐觉得，一旦激活之后，他甚至可以掰弯脚边的细钢筋。
“侍从！你在发什么呆！”
堂吉诃德的声音把李维拉回现实。这位刚刚“屠龙”完毕的骑士，正浑身湿漉漉地挥舞着那本施工手册，神情亢奋。
“看！这上面记载了女巫城堡的确切位置......”他紧闭着双眼，倒着拿手册，又正过来看了看，“虽然上面的如尼文字有点难懂，但是相信本骑士，给我一点时间我就可以破解它。”
“当然，骑士大人，”李维活动了一下脖子，“我们该回去了。今晚的战果已经足够丰厚。”
但是没想到他们刚走两步，一束手电筒的灯光就打在了他们的身上。
“~谁~，谁在那里！”
一个快要哭出来的声音颤颤巍巍地飘了出来。
李维却是听出了声音的主人，开口道：“是我，王强先生，我是李维。”

“李......维，你是那个被奸商坑了的小伙子！”
手电筒关闭，之前李维在里昂的回收店里见过的拖家带口来到美利坚的王强从一叠砖块后走了出来。
李维懒得解释这个问题，反而是好奇地看向王强：
“王强先生，你怎么在这里？”
听到李维的话，王强老脸一红，摆了摆手：“我......在家里闲不住，出来晚上找点事情做打发一下时间。”
李维却是从他身上的反光背心看出来了，他应该跟堂吉诃德一样都是在工地里工作，只不过一个可能是白天搬砖，一个可能是值夜，所以两者从不认识。
“这是你的叔叔？”王强指了指身着盔甲的堂吉诃德，“你们晚上跑到工地上干什么？”
content_en:
Unlike before, this force was not a gurgling warm current, but like a rushing river, roughly washing away every blood vessel and nerve in Levi's body.
This huge force hit his chest like a hammer, causing a huge resonance.
The sudden burst of energy made him feel dizzy, and his heart beat violently in his chest. Each beat brought more oxygen than before.
After a few seconds, the dizzy feeling slowly disappeared, replaced by an all-round sense of sublimation.
He tried making a fist.
Judging from the fact that the clothes did not swell, his figure seemed to have not changed much, but the skin on his palms seemed to have become tougher. He touched his forearm muscles, which were as tight as steel cables.
If the strength of 1.1 makes him still an ordinary fitness enthusiast with some training years, then the strength of 1.2 makes him feel as if he has begun to break away from the scope of ordinary people.
He looked at the excavator next to him. Now he feels like he can jump onto a track more than 1 meter high with just one jump.
He turned his attention to the newly acquired [Frenzy] again.
[Frenzy: After activation, strength, constitution, and agility will be doubled within 30 seconds, with no side effects. 】
[Number of uses: 1 time per day]
Although it has not been activated yet, Levi has a vague feeling that once activated, he can even bend the thin steel bars at his feet.
"Attendant! What are you doing?"
Don Quixote's voice brought Levi back to reality. The knight who had just finished "slaying the dragon" was waving the construction manual wetly, looking excited.
"Look! The exact location of the Witch's Castle is recorded on it..." He closed his eyes tightly, held the manual upside down, and looked over again. "Although the runes on it are a bit difficult to understand, trust me, this knight, give me some time and I can decipher it."
"Of course, Lord Knight," Levi stretched his neck, "We should go back. The results tonight are rich enough."
But they didn't expect that as soon as they took two steps, a flashlight light hit them.
"~Who~, who is there!"
A voice that was about to cry came out tremblingly.
But Li Wei recognized the owner of the voice and said, "It's me, Mr. Wang Qiang, I'm Li Wei."
"Li... Wei, you are the young man who was deceived by profiteers!"
The flashlight was turned off, and Wang Qiang, who brought his family to the United States, whom Levi had met in the recycling shop in Lyon before, walked out from behind a stack of bricks.
Li Wei was too lazy to explain this problem. Instead, he looked at Wang Qiang curiously:
"Mr. Wang Qiang, why are you here?"
Hearing Li Wei's words, Wang Qiang blushed and waved his hand: "I... can't stay idle at home, so I went out to find something to do in the evening to pass the time."
Levi could tell from the reflective vest on his body that he probably worked at the construction site like Don Quixote, but one might be moving bricks during the day and the other might be on night duty, so the two never knew each other.
"Is this your uncle?" Wang Qiang pointed to Don Quixote in armor, "Why are you doing this at the construction site at night?"
